Position Summary

We are looking for a Junior Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of data integration pipelines and data warehouse solutions. requirements: Prepare technical documentation and support implementation activities
Strong SQL knowledge
Database concepts (RDBMS)
ETL concepts and data integration
Data Warehousing fundamentals (Fact & Dimension modeling, Star Schema)
Data validation and reconciliation
Basic performance tuning concepts
Analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication and teamwork
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
0–2 years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL, or Database Development
Basic knowledge of scripting (Python or Shell) is a plus
responsibilities: Develop and maintain ETL/data integration pipelines
Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries and database objects
Support data loading, transformation, and validation processes
Monitor data pipelines and investigate production issues
Perform data reconciliation and quality checks
Assist with data migration, deployment, and performance optimization
Work with cross-functional teams to understand data
